_comment: Radxa's kernel for the Dragon Q6A, from its qcs6490-trixie apt suite (Release 2026-09-24). Its packaging repository at tag 7.0.11-7 pins the kernel tree radxa/kernel at a50eb5b71984bd82b49cd5d31b1e2eb5505c6512 (submodule src), built with defconfig + radxa.config and bindeb-pkg. The board's firmware for its GPU and audio: Radxa's radxa-firmware-qcs6490 (the GPU's zap shader, the audio DSP's image), the AudioReach topology and the ALSA use-case profiles of Radxa's suite, and Debian's firmware-qcom-soc (the Adreno 660 family's sqe and gmu files), which is in non-free-firmware, a component the image's snapshot does not enable. Laboratory image only: the Qualcomm binaries are not redistributed with MUN OS.

packages.name: radxa-firmware-qcs6490
packages.license: Packaging GPL-3+ (Radxa); the Qualcomm GPU and DSP firmware it carries states no licence of its own

packages.name: firmware-qcom-audioreach
packages.license: Packaging GPL-3+ (Radxa); the topologies come from Linaro's audioreach-topology under its own licence

packages.name: firmware-qcom-soc
packages.license: Qualcomm firmware, redistributable under its linux-firmware licence (Debian non-free-firmware)
